page_title: ROM 3-1 GEN | AS Roma v Genoa 29/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+1' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked. The ball goes out of play. AS Roma are awarded a corner kick.
87' 3 - 1 Goal! Jeff Ekhator (Genoa) picks up the ball inside the box, finds himself in a good position and fires in a shot which is deflected past Mile Svilar. He makes it 3:1.
86' Handball by Paulo Dybala (AS Roma).
86' Gian Piero Gasperini prepares a substitution. Wesley Franca is replaced by Devyne Rensch (AS Roma).
85' The game has come to an end for Evan Ferguson. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Artem Dovbyk (AS Roma).
84' Seydou Fini (Genoa) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
82' The ball falls for Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) in the box, and he hits a first-time shot at goal that is inadvertently blocked by a defender. A bit unlucky there!
81' Jan Ziolkowski (AS Roma) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
80' Jan Ziolkowski (AS Roma) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
79' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Morten Frendrup walks off the pitch to be replaced by Patrizio Masini (Genoa).
74' Gian Piero Gasperini decides to make a substitution. Gianluca Mancini will be replaced by Daniele Ghilardi (AS Roma).
74' Substitution. Niccolo Pisilli (AS Roma) has come on for Bryan Cristante.
73' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) hits a screaming first-time shot from the edge of the box from a clearance, but it flies a whisker wide of the left post.
73' The corner is swung in but AS Roma can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

72' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) had a great opportunity from mid-range. His powerful volley was directed towards the right side of the goal, but Daniele Sommariva was alert and made an astonishing save! AS Roma will take a corner kick.
72' Today's match ends for Vitinha who will be replaced by Jeff Ekhator (Genoa).
72' Seydou Fini (Genoa) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
70' Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
65' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
65' Mario Hermoso (AS Roma) gets himself onto the end of the corner, but his header is blocked.
65' AS Roma have been awarded a corner kick.
62' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) tries an acrobatic volley inside the box that disappears way over the bar.
62' Sebastian Otoa (Genoa) attempts a nice header from inside the penalty area, but his effort is blocked.
59' Substitution. Seydou Fini (Genoa) on for Ruslan Malinovskyi.
59' Substitution. Caleb Ekuban is replaced by Lorenzo Colombo (Genoa).
58' Daniele De Rossi has decided to substitute Leo Ostigard and he is replaced by Alessandro Marcandalli (Genoa).
57' AS Roma have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
57' Matias Soule (AS Roma) is not able to continue due to his injury and will be replaced by Stephan El Shaarawy.
56' Matias Soule (AS Roma) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
56' Zeki Celik (AS Roma) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The referee blows his whistle, AS Roma are awarded a corner kick.
51' Evan Ferguson (AS Roma) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way wide of the left post.
50' Morten Frendrup (Genoa) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
48' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Genoa.
47' Aaron Martin (Genoa) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Genoa.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' Marco Di Bello blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Leo Ostigard (Genoa) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.

45+2' Leo Ostigard (Genoa) outjumped the defenders to meet the ball from the free kick and plants a precise header from deep inside the box towards the net! The goalkeeper shows his reflexes and superbly keeps the ball out!
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
45' AS Roma take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

45' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) had a golden opportunity. He volleyed from point blank range towards the roof of the net, but Daniele Sommariva was alert and made an amazing save! Corner kick. AS Roma will have an opportunity.
41' Vitinha (Genoa) fires the ball towards goal from just outside the penalty area, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar after coming very close to hitting the roof of the net.
38' Goal disallowed! Manu Kone (AS Roma) scores but Marco Di Bello blows his whistle for a foul.
38' Manu Kone (AS Roma) has a big opportunity inside the penalty area, pulls the trigger, but one of the defending players is in the way of his shot and the ball bounces onto the post off him.
37' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) fires a shot high over the bar from inside the box after latching onto a short pass.
33' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Caleb Ekuban (Genoa) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
31' 3 - 0 Goal! Evan Ferguson (AS Roma) slots the ball into an unguarded net from close range after a shot rebounds off a defender. 3:0.
31' Matias Soule (AS Roma) beats a few defenders in the penalty area and drives a low shot towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper reacts superbly to make a wonderful save.
26' Johan Vasquez (Genoa) is caught offside!
22' Aaron Martin (Genoa) fails to convert the free kick after the ball is blocked by the defensive wall.
19' 2 - 0 Goal! Evan Ferguson plays it to Manu Kone (AS Roma), whose deflected shot from inside the box goes past the helpless Daniele Sommariva. 2:0.
18' The resulting set piece from AS Roma is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

17' Evan Ferguson (AS Roma) aims for the middle of the goal, but that's an easy job for the goalkeeper. It will take more than that to test him! The linesman points to the corner flag, AS Roma are going to take it.
14' 1 - 0 Goal! Matias Soule (AS Roma) gets a shot away from inside the box and the effort is deflected past the goalkeeper. 1:0.
13' Dangerous play by Vitinha (Genoa). Marco Di Bello blows his whistle for a foul.
11' Marco Di Bello blows his whistle and it's Ruslan Malinovskyi (Genoa) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
6' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) is adjudged offside.
4' Brooke Norton-Cuffy (Genoa) latches on to a cross but heads the ball miles wide of the right post. Such a bad header.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out and the match is about to start. AS Roma will have the kick-off.
The referee of today's match will be Marco Di Bello.
